elements.name: intro_text
elements.html:
Welcome to CodeAI's 2026-27 Check-In Survey for CSD & AID teachers

CodeAI relies on surveys as a crucial tool to remain connected to teachers, and to give you the opportunity to provide feedback about your experience teaching our curriculum.

The purpose of this survey is to better understand our teachers' experience with CodeAI's CS Discoveries and AI Discoveries Courses and your plans to continue teaching. 

Privacy and Confidentiality

  • Your individual responses here are completely confidential.
  • Your identity will never be revealed publicly or used to tie any responses back to you personally.
  • We may share de-identified, aggregate data (representing all responses) publicly.
  • Your de-identified responses will be used by CodeAI to improve our curriculum and programs.

This survey should take less than 5 minutes to complete.  Your complete honesty and candor are appreciated.

elements.name: survey_header
elements.html: According to our records, you taught CS Discoveries content in School Year 2025-26. We would like to know more about your plans for teaching a middle school Computer Science and AI curriculum again this year.

elements.name: plans_next_sy_reasons
elements.title: Please select the reason(s) why you are not teaching CS Discoveries or AI Discoveries yet this school year

choices.text: I plan to teach the course later this year
I am not teaching computer science and AI anymore
I am not teaching, but another teacher will continue teaching the course
There is not enough student enrollment to continue teaching the course
The content of the course is no longer aligned with my classroom's learning objectives
The course won't be taught at my school this year
I want to teach other content that is more focused on AI
I am not interested in the course now that it incorporates AI concepts
Given scheduling constraints, the course is no longer offered
Learning computer science is no longer a priority given what AI is able to do
I have developed my own materials for teaching about computer science and AI
I no longer need to teach about computer science and AI
Another provider meets my needs better
CodeAI's curriculum did not meet district or school requirements

elements.name: other_feedback_FR
elements.title: Is there anything else you would like to share about your experience teaching computer science and AI with the CS Discoveries curriculum? Your constructive feedback is essential for us to improve our curriculum, and we appreciate you sharing it with us.

elements.name: participate_focus_group_6_8
elements.title: OPTIONAL: Would you be willing to participate in a follow-up focus group to provide direct feedback about your experience teaching computer science and AI for middle school? We are really interested in hearing from teachers to help us improve our curriculum for these students.

elements.name: aif_email_focus_group
elements.title: Great! Please share an email address where we may contact you.

elements.name: thank_you
elements.html:
Thank You!

Thanks from CodeAI for your time, thoughts, and passion for teaching.
